scope: Add a fallible mutable image builder interface for derived allocation and clear dispatch over registered base storage. Existing concrete image behavior is unchanged.
implementation_provenance: Image source projection and post-clear split adapted from preserved clipping candidate cbace6cb9; unpublished API refined to typed request/errors. No historical native fixture imported.
consumer_gap: Main offers concrete image allocation but no callable derived image allocation/clear interface retaining registered image storage. ImagePixMapSource now supplies that builder entrypoint. ToPixMap and driver signatures are unchanged.
boundary: Mutable builder adapter, not a published geometry operation result or validation certificate. No immutable image, receiver lifetime, whole-operation completion, or rendering acceptance claim. The source type is diagnostic context, not a unique or persistent image entity identifier.
api: ImageAllocationRequest retains format, dimensions and requested stride; depth one selects a 2D image.
ImagePixMapSource::allocate_image and clear_image return Result<(), ImageSourceError>.
image_pix_map_original_base returns a borrow or typed missing-registration error without panic.
ImageSourceError records operation, dynamic source type, failure class, allocation request when applicable and optional original Failure cause.
The existing bool allocator supplies no failure cause; AllocationRefused has cause=None rather than an invented diagnosis.
Callback causes are preserved, including exception type, message and stack; Error::source exposes the original Failure.
version_policy: New unpublished additive builder interface; no existing public contract or baseline changed. Existing behavior remains selectable through unchanged concrete methods; no breaking migration or behavior version change is introduced. Release versioning remains with the coordinator.
isolation: Uses existing safe Transient::project; no unsafe, constructed owner, retirement, observer or weak upgrade code imported.
Projection only borrows existing storage and cannot extend its source lifetime; compile-fail doctest pins this boundary.
Source trait inherits Send + Sync; context types have compile-time assertions. This is not new stress/TSan evidence.
Zero-depth refusal is preserved; candidate zero-fill convenience with different behavior was omitted.
expected_kind: Owned current-behavior fixtures and independent byte counts, explicit fill values, identity and hook-count assertions. No live OCCT oracle.

build_environment.note: Pre-refactor fixture build used -j4 before coordinator requested jobs=2.

superseded_checks: post-extraction-tests.log.gz, clippy.log.gz and format.log.gz describe the earlier unpublished bool interface before coordinator review.
typed-tests.log.gz predates final error payload boxing.
typed-clippy-initial.log.gz records the large-error diagnostic; final API boxes only the optional supplied Failure.
typed-error-source-red.log.gz records the preserved-cause downcast regression; Error::source now borrows through the box, and the same test passes.
exclusions: No live OCCT, GPU, performance, package release, Miri, loom or ThreadSanitizer executions.
Preserved dump branch aa17f7e48 and its two red retirement diagnostics are unchanged.
No whole ToPixMap completion or final rendering acceptance.
style_audit: All added functions at most 20 lines after formatting; modules below 500 lines; no nested callback closures.
documentation_after_checks: Only the source_type field comment was clarified after the final TKService test run; no implementation changed. Scoped formatter recheck and consumer compile passed afterward.
integration: Awaiting coordinator integration into main; neither original dump nor clipping lifetime branch is imported.
